baslik_html: Yabancı bir repo açmak makineyi ele geçirmeye yetti.
alt_satir: Codex'in sanal alanı iki ayrı yoldan delindi.
cizim_svg:
<svg width="630" height="630" viewBox="-280 -280 560 560">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="sweep" cx="0" cy="0" r="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#3DDC97" stop-opacity="0.18"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#3DDC97" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <marker id="ok" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto">
      <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#FF5A5F"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- radar grid -->
  <circle r="260" fill="none" stroke="#1E2A44" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle r="195" fill="none" stroke="#1E2A44" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="-260" y1="0" x2="260" y2="0" stroke="#1E2A44" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="-260" x2="0" y2="260" stroke="#1E2A44" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M0,0 L260,0 A260,260 0 0,0 184,-184 Z" fill="url(#sweep)" transform="rotate(205)"/>

  <!-- sandbox boundary -->
  <rect x="-145" y="-68" width="290" height="136" rx="16"
        fill="rgba(61,220,151,0.07)" stroke="#3DDC97" stroke-width="3" stroke-dasharray="10 8"/>
  <text x="0" y="-84" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono" font-size="17"
        font-weight="700" fill="#3DDC97" letter-spacing="2">SANDBOX · SALT OKUNUR</text>

  <!-- inside: agent and untrusted repo -->
  <line x1="-54" y1="0" x2="54" y2="0" stroke="#1E2A44" stroke-width="3"/>
  <circle cx="-72" cy="0" r="13" fill="#3DDC97"/>
  <text x="-72" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono" font-size="16"
        font-weight="700" fill="#F2F5FA">AJAN</text>
  <circle cx="72" cy="0" r="18" fill="#FF5A5F" opacity="0.25"/>
  <circle cx="72" cy="0" r="9" fill="#FF5A5F"/>
  <text x="58" y="36" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono" font-size="16"
        font-weight="700" fill="#FF5A5F">REPO</text>

  <!-- escape 1: heapjack -->
  <line x1="-84" y1="-14" x2="-186" y2="-152" stroke="#FF5A5F" stroke-width="2.5"
        stroke-dasharray="7 6" marker-end="url(#ok)"/>
  <circle cx="-196" cy="-166" r="18" fill="#FF5A5F" opacity="0.25"/>
  <circle cx="-196" cy="-166" r="9" fill="#FF5A5F"/>
  <text x="-196" y="-200" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono" font-size="18"
        font-weight="700" fill="#FF5A5F">HEAPJACK</text>

  <!-- escape 2: overpatch -->
  <line x1="84" y1="14" x2="186" y2="152" stroke="#FF5A5F" stroke-width="2.5"
        stroke-dasharray="7 6" marker-end="url(#ok)"/>
  <circle cx="196" cy="166" r="18" fill="#FF5A5F" opacity="0.25"/>
  <circle cx="196" cy="166" r="9" fill="#FF5A5F"/>
  <text x="196" y="208" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono" font-size="18"
        font-weight="700" fill="#FF5A5F">OVERPATCH</text>

  <!-- what both achieve -->
  <text x="0" y="116" text-anchor="middle" font-family="JetBrains Mono" font-size="16"
        font-weight="700" fill="#8A97B1" letter-spacing="1">SANDBOX DIŞINDA KOD ÇALIŞTIRMA</text>
</svg>
